appDid.description: The Bazaar storefront DID (a did:web) that signs purchase.receipt / purchase.consent / bazaarIdentifier records on this merchant's behalf. A verifier can resolve appDid to /.well-known/did.json for the storefront's verification keys, or use the embedded keyHistory below. Lets the storefront trust chain be checked from the merchant's own repo, not only from a receipt's appDid field.

keyHistory.description: Mirror of the appDid DID document's keyHistory array: every non-current storefront signing key, ordered oldest to newest, so a verifier can check this merchant's historical records without a separate DID-document fetch. NOT YET automatically synchronized on storefront key rotation — this field may be absent or stale until that write path exists (see diamonds.whereditgo.bazaar / ADR 0013).

updatedAt.description: Set on every write to this record.

keyHistoryEntry.description: One non-current storefront signing key, mirroring an entry of the appDid DID document's keyHistory. A complete Multikey verification method plus the forward supersededBy link and an optional revoked flag.

id.description: Full DID URL of the key, e.g. did:web:bazaar.whereditgo.diamonds#merchant-key-2026-04-17.

controller.description: The storefront DID that controls this key (equals appDid).

publicKeyMultibase.description: Multibase (z...) encoding of the P-256 public key, per the Multikey / did:key convention.

supersededBy.description: Full DID URL of the key that became current after this one. The newest entry points at the storefront's current signing key.

revoked.description: True = hard-revoked: signatures made by this key are rejected outright. Absent = retired but still trusted for records it signed before rotation.
